description: This Java class 'FileUtil' provides various utility methods for file operations such as reading, writing, zipping, unzipping, path normalization, and file searching within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: FileUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for file handling operations such as reading, writing, zipping, unzipping, and path normalization.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns a File object for a given path, resolving component:// URLs if necessary.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a string to a file, with optional encoding.

methods.name: writeString (overloaded)
methods.description: Writes a string to a file with specified encoding and output file.

methods.name: getBufferedWriter
methods.description: Creates a BufferedWriter for a given file path and name.

methods.name: getBufferedOutputStream
methods.description: Creates a BufferedOutputStream for a given file path and name.

methods.name: getPatchedFileName
methods.description: Constructs a valid file name with directory creation if needed.

methods.name: readTextFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a text file into a StringBuffer, optionally including newlines.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into a String with specified encoding.

methods.name: searchFiles
methods.description: Recursively searches for files matching a filter within a directory.

methods.name: findFiles
methods.description: Finds files with specific extension and optional search strings within a base directory.

methods.name: findXmlFiles
methods.description: Finds XML files containing specific root elements or DTD/XSD references.

methods.name: containsString (Reader)
methods.description: Checks if a given Reader contains a specific string.

methods.name: containsString (String, String)
methods.description: Checks if a file contains a specific string.

methods.name: isFile
methods.description: Checks if a given filename exists and is a file.

methods.name: zipFileStream
methods.description: Creates a zip stream from an InputStream with a filename.

methods.name: zipFileStreams
methods.description: Creates a zip stream from a map of filenames to InputStreams.

methods.name: newFile
methods.description: Prevents Zip Slip vulnerability by validating zip entry paths.

methods.name: unzipFileToFolder
methods.description: Extracts a zip file to a specified folder, optionally handling Zip Slip.

methods.name: createFileWithNormalizedPath
methods.description: Creates a File object with a normalized path to prevent traversal issues.

methods.name: normalizeFilePath
methods.description: Returns a normalized string path to prevent traversal issues.

methods.name: unZip
methods.description: Extracts a zip file to a destination, optionally with password, handling Zip Slip.
